questions.question: What is the capital of the United Kingdom?
questions.explanation: London is the capital of the United Kingdom (UK).

questions.question: How many states does the USA have?
questions.explanation: The USA has 50 states. It is a big country with many different regions.

questions.question: Which country has kangaroos?
questions.explanation: Australia is famous for kangaroos and koalas!

questions.question: What languages are spoken in Canada?
questions.explanation: Canada is bilingual - people speak both English and French.

questions.question: When is summer in Australia?
questions.explanation: Australia is in the Southern Hemisphere, so summer is in December (opposite of Norway).
